name: storyteller-configuration
description: The conformance suite of the Storyteller configuration providers and SDKs: how a configuration becomes flat keys, the exact text of the flat formats, how an answer of the platform maps to an error, and how a refresh behaves. Every provider runs the files of the kinds it implements, fails on a kind it does not know, and states the version it passes. A vector is identified by its file and its name; a flattening file by its target.
